title: Update Nightscout REST API to v3
body:
As described in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/475#issuecomment-850774431, we should support the new Nightscout REST API to track changes and deletions better.

List of tasks to implement:
- [ ] determine Nightscout REST API version
- [ ] show API version in Nightscout Uploader and Follower status page
- [ ] create a new class for new API
- [ ] create a Factory class to instantiate the correct Nightscout communication class
- [ ] implement new commands like corrected sgv (#1090) or changed/deleted treatments (#1403)
- [ ] merge Uploader and Follower source code to avoid similar problems like #1807 addresses
- [ ] support uploading of activity
- [ ] support for the new Transmitter ID and Sensor Code fields (#1624)
- [ ] incorporate it into a sync framework

The requests which be used for the new REST API are described at [HTTP Methods](https://restfulapi.net/http-methods).

comments.body:
@sulkaharo API v3 UPDATE does not support an eventType or note for svg entries. Does it matter?

Any further hints?
@Icke12 You just quoted my description. What do you want to say?

@sulkaharo 
Would you please tell us what the need is for updating to V3?  
What do we lose if we don't update?
What do we gain if we update?

I have been told the following two statements.
  
- xDrip does not delete or update any records.  Therefore, there is no need to change from V1 to V3.  
  
- Since AAPS 3.2, if AAPS uses xDrip as the CGM source, AAPS does all the uploading to Nightscout.  
  
Taking those into consideration, I am closing this issue.  Of course, we can reopen if needed.
